features.title: Versatile seating for every occasion
features.text: The Pangram sofa adapts to your needs, whether you’re hosting guests or simply enjoying a quiet moment, offering comfortable experience.

features.title: Armrests for added ergonomic comfort
features.text: The broad armrests provide a comfortable resting space, letting you sit back and unwind with ease.

features.title: Soft fabric upholstery for long-lasting comfort
features.text: Crafted with durable fabric, this sofa feels soft to the touch while standing up to regular use, making it a practical choice for family spaces.

features.title: Tailored comfort with loose cushions
features.text: Portable loose cushions that adapt to personal comfort preferences for a cosy atmosphere.

features.title: Elevated design that makes cleaning simple
features.text: Raised legs make vacuuming or sweeping underneath effortless, helping you maintain a neat and tidy home.
